name: sdk/v2.41.0
body:
<!-- generated-release-notes v1 -->

## ⚠️ Breaking changes

- Let every application admin manage a workspace-shared connection ([#25773](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/25773)) by @abdulrahmancodes

## ✨ New features

- feat(view): seed a user-owned initial view per object alongside the INDEX view ([#25416](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/25416)) by @thomtrp
- feat(usage-limit): expose usage limits over the metadata API ([#25740](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/25740)) by @etiennejouan
- feat(workflow): point core workflows and command menu items at core version ids ([#25757](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/25757)) by @thomtrp
- feat(skills): split agent-only skills from user skills, rewrite the catalog ([#25798](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/25798)) by @FelixMalfait
- feat(messaging): let apps own message channels ([#25903](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/25903)) by @FelixMalfait
- feat(messaging): let apps ingest messages into their channels ([#25905](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/25905)) by @FelixMalfait
- feat(messaging): resolve identity for non-email participants ([#25906](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/25906)) by @FelixMalfait

## 💅 Improvements & UX

- Record sharing: inherited objects follow their parent ([#25439](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/25439)) by @martmull
- Support explicit widget height behavior ([#25512](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/25512)) by @Bonapara
- Simplify page layout manifest authoring ([#25513](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/25513)) by @Bonapara
- [1/4] Desktop Recorder: support existing UI controls ([#25632](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/25632)) by @Bonapara
- Replace frontend snackbars with twenty-ui toasts ([#25664](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/25664)) by @bosiraphael
- Stop pull overwriting a source file that defines no entity ([#25739](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/25739)) by @Weiko
- Write pulled standalone page layout widgets as define files ([#25743](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/25743)) by @Weiko
- Stop calling a local file unknown to the workspace when the export reported it ([#25746](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/25746)) by @Weiko
- Tell pull users their project cannot build what pull just wrote ([#25747](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/25747)) by @Weiko
- Refuse to pull an application into a project that already defines another ([#25750](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/25750)) by @Weiko
- Restrict AI and Settings access during layout editing ([#25760](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/25760)) by @Bonapara
- Validate select option colors ([#25805](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/25805)) by @bosiraphael
- Point pull users at the apply flag that protects what it could not write ([#25808](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/25808)) by @Weiko
- Polish AI model settings ([#25810](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/25810)) by @Bonapara
- Let runAgent messages carry file attachments ([#25835](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/25835)) by @abdulrahmancodes
- Lay the app out right to left for Arabic and Hebrew ([#25854](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/25854)) by @FelixMalfait
- Migrate buttons to Base UI ([#25888](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/25888)) by @bosiraphael
- Add live previews to Twenty UI documentation ([#25889](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/25889)) by @bosiraphael
- Remove the email group flag and gate campaigns behind their own flag ([#25916](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/25916)) by @neo773
- Show AI chat context and credit usage ([#25923](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/25923)) by @Bonapara
- Organize Twenty UI into primitive families ([#25948](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/25948)) by @bosiraphael
- Split the admin application registration update input ([#25963](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/25963)) by @prastoin
- Derive permission universal identifiers from their role and target ([#25966](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/25966)) by @Weiko
- Redesign the marketplace app detail page ([#25969](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/25969)) by @martmull
- [1/2 Sidebar] New layout ([#25974](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/25974)) by @Bonapara
- Use Twenty UI components in presentation stories ([#25976](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/25976)) by @bosiraphael
- Desktop Recorder: align merged integration and UI naming conventions ([#25977](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/25977)) by @Bonapara
- Document data display primitives ([#25980](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/25980)) by @bosiraphael
- Write roles and permission flags on pull ([#25994](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/25994)) by @Weiko
- Use Twenty UI buttons in Menu and Popover stories ([#26001](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/26001)) by @bosiraphael
- Clip the toast progress overlay to the toast corners ([#26012](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/26012)) by @neo773
- Clarify twenty-ui setup in the README ([#26044](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/26044)) by @bosiraphael
- Document controlled and uncontrolled UI state ([#26062](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/26062)) by @bosiraphael
- Document Twenty UI anatomy and composition ([#26066](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/26066)) by @bosiraphael
- Disable play functions in UI documentation examples ([#26069](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/26069)) by @bosiraphael
- Make record sharing an enterprise feature ([#26070](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/26070)) by @martmull
- Cache billing entitlements in the workspace cache ([#26078](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/26078)) by @Weiko

## 🐛 Bug fixes

- fix(storybook): prevent oversized Argos screenshots ([#25779](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/25779)) by @bosiraphael
- fix(create-twenty-app): ship a lockfile so generated apps install under an age gate ([#25879](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/25879)) by @FelixMalfait

## 🔧 Developer & API

- Align twenty-ui with SDK package versions ([#25758](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/25758)) by @bosiraphael
- Migrate Status to the new twenty-ui API ([#25785](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/25785)) by @bosiraphael
- Migrate Tag to the new twenty-ui API ([#25786](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/25786)) by @bosiraphael
- Migrate Avatar to the new twenty-ui API ([#25787](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/25787)) by @bosiraphael
- Migrate Chip to the new twenty-ui API ([#25788](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/25788)) by @bosiraphael
- Add Twenty UI documentation and generated API references ([#25791](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/25791)) by @bosiraphael

<details>
<summary>🏗️ Internal changes (1)</summary>

- refactor(server): bind resolved application packages to their registration ([#26077](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/26077)) by @prastoin

</details>

## 🎉 New contributors

- @mydd7 made their first contribution in https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/25674
